name: Disable Automatic TCP Adjustments
description: Prevents Windows from dynamically changing TCP behavior.
commands:
netsh int tcp set heuristics disabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=disabled
revert22H2:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
revert23H2:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
revert24H2:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
revertCommands:
netsh int tcp set heuristics enabled
netsh int tcp set heuristics wsh=enabled
